_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro: Kuna wasa Golf (Katin Wasanni) - Mai kunnawa {player_id}. Goal: Samu mafi ƙarancin jimillar maki a cikin wannan zagaye ɗaya. Idan ginshiƙai suna da darajar iri ɗaya, ana haɗa su da 0. Card Values: A = 1, 2-10 = face value, J / Q = 10, K = 0 Ayyuka (amfani da madaidaitan ƙuƙwalwa): - '[draw]' - Zana daga bene - '[take]' - Ɗauki daga tarin da aka watsar - '[swap X Y]' - Swap da aka zana katin tare da matsayi X ( jere) Y (shafi) - '[discard]' - Yi watsi da katin da aka zana

board.drew: Ka zana: {card} Yanzu dole ne ka [swap X Y] ko [discard] shi.
board.took: Kun ɗauki: {card} daga tarin zubar da ku Dole ne ku [swap X Y] tare da shi (ba za ku iya zubar da shi ba).

options.must_swap: Dole ne ku: [swap X Y] (ba za ku iya yin watsi da katunan daga tarin da aka yi watsi da su ba)
options.swap_or_discard: Dole ne ku: [swap X Y] ko [discard]

action_desc.swapped: Mai kunnawa {pid} ya canza {new} tare da {old} a matsayi ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: Ƙungiyar wasan karta ƙalilan take! Wasan ya ƙare nan take.
message.knocked: Mai kunnawa {pid} ya buga! Kowane ɗan wasa yana da ƙarin juyi ɗaya.
message.final_round: Mai kunnawa {pid} {reason}! Kowane ɗan wasa yana samun ƙarin juyi ɗaya.

invalid.wrong_action: Yi amfani da daidai DAYA aikin da aka yi amfani da shi: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], ko [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: Ƙungiyar karta ƙi ajiyewa ƙalilan take!
invalid.must_draw_first: Dole ne ku fara [draw], [take], [knock], ko [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Ba za ka iya yin watsi da katin da aka dauka daga tarin da aka watsar ba. Dole ne ka musanya shi.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Kana da katin da aka zana. Dole ne ka [swap X Y] ko [discard] shi.
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kana bukatar katin da aka zana don musayar.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kana bukatar katin da aka zana don ka watsar.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Matsayi daga cikin iyakoki. Yi amfani da jere 1-{max_row}, shafi 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Ba za ka iya buga tare da katin da aka zana ba. Ka kammala juyawarka da farko.
invalid.already_knocked: Wani ya riga ya buga wannan zagaye.
invalid.already_revealed: An riga an bayyana wannan katin!
